WITH inv AS (SELECT strftime(CAST(day AS DATE), '%Y-%m') AS month, factory, AVG(qty_t) AS avg_qty FROM fact_inventory_day WHERE item_type='原料' GROUP BY 1,2), outp AS (SELECT month, factory, SUM(input_t)/COUNT(DISTINCT month) AS mth_input, SUM(input_t) AS tot_input FROM fact_production GROUP BY 1,2) SELECT month, AVG(inv.avg_qty)/(SUM(outp.tot_input)/30.0) AS value FROM inv JOIN outp USING (month, factory) WHERE factory = '成都厂' AND month >= '2025-06' AND month <= '2025-06' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

WITH inv AS (SELECT strftime(CAST(day AS DATE), '%Y-%m') AS month, factory, item, AVG(amt_ky) AS avg_amt FROM fact_inventory_day WHERE item_type='成品' GROUP BY 1,2,3), sale AS (SELECT month, factory, SUM(amount_yuan)/1000.0 AS sale_ky FROM fact_sales GROUP BY 1,2) SELECT month, SUM(inv.avg_amt)/(SUM(sale.sale_ky)/30.0) AS value FROM inv JOIN sale USING (month, factory) WHERE factory = '成都厂' AND month >= '2025-06' AND month <= '2025-06' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

WITH f AS (SELECT month, product, ingredient, pct/100.0 AS r FROM fact_formula), p AS (SELECT month, factory, ingredient, SUM(qty_t*unit_price)/SUM(qty_t) AS price FROM fact_purchase GROUP BY 1,2,3), y AS (SELECT month, factory, product, SUM(output_t)/SUM(input_t) AS yield_rate FROM fact_production GROUP BY 1,2,3) SELECT month, SUM(f.r*p.price)/MAX(y.yield_rate) AS value FROM f JOIN p USING (month, ingredient) JOIN y USING (month, factory, product) WHERE factory = '成都厂' AND product = '草鱼料' AND month >= '2025-07' AND month <= '2025-08' GROUP BY month ORDER BY month

WITH f AS (SELECT month, product, ingredient, pct/100.0 AS r FROM fact_formula),
    p AS (SELECT month, factory, ingredient, SUM(qty_t*unit_price)/SUM(qty_t) AS price
          FROM fact_purchase GROUP BY 1,2,3),
    q AS (SELECT ingredient, supplier, AVG(protein_pct) AS prot FROM fact_qc_batch GROUP BY 1,2),
    pp AS (SELECT p.month, p.factory, p.ingredient, p.price,
                  AVG(q.prot) AS prot
           FROM p JOIN fact_purchase po ON po.month=p.month AND po.factory=p.factory
                AND po.ingredient=p.ingredient
           JOIN q ON q.ingredient=po.ingredient AND q.supplier=po.supplier
           GROUP BY 1,2,3,4)
    SELECT f.month, f.product, pp.factory,
           SUM(f.r*pp.price)/NULLIF(SUM(f.r*pp.prot),0) AS value
    FROM f JOIN pp ON f.month=pp.month AND f.ingredient=pp.ingredient
    GROUP BY 1,2,3

WITH f AS (SELECT month, product, ingredient, pct/100.0 AS r FROM fact_formula),
    p AS (SELECT month, factory, ingredient, SUM(qty_t*unit_price)/SUM(qty_t) AS price
          FROM fact_purchase GROUP BY 1,2,3),
    q AS (SELECT ingredient, supplier, AVG(protein_pct) AS prot FROM fact_qc_batch GROUP BY 1,2),
    pp AS (SELECT p.month, p.factory, p.ingredient, p.price,
                  AVG(q.prot) AS prot
           FROM p JOIN fact_purchase po ON po.month=p.month AND po.factory=p.factory
                AND po.ingredient=p.ingredient
           JOIN q ON q.ingredient=po.ingredient AND q.supplier=po.supplier
           GROUP BY 1,2,3,4)
    SELECT f.month, f.product, pp.factory,
           SUM(f.r*pp.price)/NULLIF(SUM(f.r*pp.prot),0) AS value
    FROM f JOIN pp ON f.month=pp.month AND f.ingredient=pp.ingredient
    GROUP BY 1,2,3
